name: io.github.jakub-m-arch/intervals-icu-mcp
title: Intervals.icu
description: Read and plan your training in Intervals.icu: activities, fitness, wellness, calendar and workouts.

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_ICU_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from Intervals.icu → Settings → Developer Settings

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_ICU_ATHLETE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Athlete id. Defaults to 0 (the athlete that owns the API key).

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_ICU_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: read-only, safe (default) or full. Deletes need full.

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_ICU_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable on top of the defaults.
